verdict.rationale: Official SDKs are a fair question for a cloud platform like Railway, so the axis applies. The evidence documents an official CLI, an MCP server, agent skills and plugins/connectors, but none of these is a language SDK, and no evidence names an official Railway SDK. The OpenAPI probe found nothing at any candidate path, so there is not even a published spec to generate one from. Those adjacent tools earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
